title: Microsoft Copilot: Excel Agent builds charts, summaries and formulas from your data
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing caveat and documented controls are supported. One descriptive statement needs narrowing because Microsoft names Office Agent, not Excel Agent, as potentially visible in the store when unusable. The licence-inventory checklist also names a control not represented in the table.
